video_title: Shaq's Competitive “Beef” with Kobe Bryant & Secret to Getting Girls with Druski

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaq on his competitive relationship with Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: Kobe is probably one of the only guys I'm jealous of because the way he does his stuff.

text_blocks.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
text_blocks.text: Kobe is probably one of the only guys I'm jealous of because the way he does his stuff is something I've always wanted to start. I've always wanted to start an Ebonics Sports Network. There's two ways to talk: there's the corporate way like we all talk, and then how he does it. When I first heard him and saw him, I started following him. He was nice to me and we've been friends ever since. Whenever Bob calls out, I'm always there for Bob because he makes me laugh. He does stuff that I wish I could do.

text_blocks.speaker: Bob Menery
text_blocks.text: I wish me and Shaq could talk like he talks on TNT. That would definitely bring the ratings up.

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaq on his competitive edge against Michael Jordan
quotes.excerpt: I take pride in being the last guy to beat Michael Jordan in a playoff situation.
quotes.quote: I take pride in saying I was the last one to beat Michael Jordan in a playoff situation. Everybody is going to say, 'Oh, he came back from baseball,' but my thing is if you step on that court, that means you're ready to go. I played with Penny Hardaway, Kobe Bryant, Dwyane Wade, LeBron James, Steve Nash. If you aren't on that level, I don't know what great is. I know he's a really good player on his way, but to try to crown him as the next, and then I said, 'Okay, if he's crowned the next, where is he ranked?' And then, you know, people were saying five, six, seven. I said, 'Well, I don't know where y'all come from, but being fifth is not acceptable to me. If I'm not number one or number two, don't bring my name up ever.'

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaq on his competitive relationship with Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: I don't compare anybody to Mike, but if I had to answer the question, Kobe is the closest thing to Mike.
quotes.quote: I don't compare anybody to Mike, but if I had to answer the question, Kobe is the closest thing to Mike. And is there somebody that's close to Kobe? No. And then I don't think they want to be compared to Kobe. I think they're trying to make their own mark, but yeah, I think this is LeBron's plan. I think he wants to pass up Kareem. Because if he passes up Kareem in points, we all got to shut the hell up. Think about it. He's going to have four rings, he already passed up Kobe, he already passed up Mike, now he passed up Kareem. So if that don't make him the greatest basketball player there is, I don't know what we're talking about.

quotes.speaker: Shaq
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaq explains his security arrangement with his uncle
quotes.excerpt: He's keeping them secure from me.
quotes.quote: My uncle was my security, but he's not keeping them secure from me. He's keeping them secure from me. He's keeping them secure from me.

quotes.speaker: Shaq
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaq's business advice on distribution and selling
quotes.excerpt: When you're in this business, first thing you need is great distribution.
quotes.quote: When you're in this business, first thing you need is great distribution. Once you have great distribution, that means you can show great numbers. And then when you can show great numbers, then it's time to sell. Everything's for sale. If you put a certain amount into it and you have that conversation, you're going to get this, and it's the top of the line, you do it.

quotes.speaker: Shaq
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaq on his career determination and being a listener
quotes.excerpt: My greatest attribute is I was a listener.
quotes.quote: I came in with determination, with a dream, with a plan, and I did it my way. A lot of ups and downs, a lot of mistakes, but I still did it my way. And again, my greatest attribute is I was a listener.

quotes.speaker: Shaq
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaq's business goals and ownership aspirations
quotes.excerpt: I want to own 30 Papa John's. I want to own 20 Krispy Kreme.
quotes.quote: I want to own Krispy Kreme. I want to own 30 Papa John's. I want to own 20 Krispy Kreme. It's just, you know, it's about owning things.

quotes.speaker: Shaq
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaq on maintaining control in business deals
quotes.excerpt: My representatives work for me. I'm in charge. I'm always the CEO.
quotes.quote: Let's just say I'm trying to do a deal with Hardy. I come in and they would Shaq me. Hey, Shaq, how are you? Then they would talk to my representatives. But my representatives work for me. I'm in charge. I'm always the CEO. They wouldn't even look at me. They talked to my guys. I was like, this has to stop.

quotes.speaker: Shaq
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaq's preference for joint ventures in business
quotes.excerpt: My favorite chapter in business school was joint ventureships.
quotes.quote: My favorite chapter in business school was joint ventureships. So if I was getting into the podcast business, I'd do a joint ventureship with some podcasters. I don't want to be in the podcast business. That's where you guys come in, and we'd have a deal. I'd invest this much, how much I'm getting back every week, or we grow, keep investing until we sell, get back that. And that's how I like to do business.

quotes.speaker: Shaq
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaq on his competitive nature and learning from success
quotes.excerpt: I like looking at all successful people and learning from them.
quotes.quote: I like looking at all successful people and learning from them. It goes back to that jealousy thing. But when I get jealous, it's not a hate thing. It's like, damn, Bob has a podcast for four people. I'm going to go get it. Like, rather than competitive in every way, right?

quotes.speaker: Shaq
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaq on the difficulty of acquiring NBA and NFL rights
quotes.excerpt: It's hard to get the rights to the NBA, NFL, they're expensive.
quotes.quote: It's hard to get the rights to the NBA, NFL, they're expensive, so you have to figure out. We tried to figure that out for a while, you know. I think these guys we kind of, you know, how could that ever, how could that ever be possible for him though? How would they ever give him the rights to do that?

quotes.speaker: Shaq
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaq on the importance of renewals in business deals
quotes.excerpt: Once you get the deal, it's about renewing the deal.
quotes.quote: Once you get the deal, it's about renewing the deal. I got 17 renewals of IC Hot. 17.
